=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- README.md:976, agents.md:234 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `REVIEW_CONSOLIDATOR_MAX_TOKENS_OUT` is documented as a byte cap, but `scripts/review_consolidate.sh` treats it as a token count and multiplies it by 4.
  WHY: An operator following the docs can set a truncation threshold that is effectively 4x different from what they intended.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3448-3462 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `consolidator_state="invoked (empty / failed)"` conflates an intentionally disabled consolidator with a real empty/failure case.
  WHY: The metrics summary cannot distinguish `REVIEW_CONSOLIDATOR_ENABLED=0` from an actual consolidator failure.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3471-3473 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `override_count="$(grep -cE '^CONSOLIDATOR_OVERRIDDEN:' ... || echo 0)"` relies on a fragile double-echo/trim interaction to produce the final count.
  WHY: The current value is only correct because later trimming discards the extra `0`, which is brittle and easy to break.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3473 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `grep -cE '^CONSOLIDATOR_OVERRIDDEN:'` depends on an exact line-start format, so any leading whitespace or format change makes the override count read as zero.
  WHY: Editor override usage would be undercounted in metrics.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:319 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `awk '$2 ~ /^(NEW|PERSISTING|RESURGENT)$/'` uses a regex match on the status field instead of an exact comparison.
  WHY: Future status strings that merely start with one of those tokens would be treated as active and expand reviewer scope.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:317-318 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `LC_ALL=C sort -u -o ... || true` swallows sort failures.
  WHY: I/O or permission errors can silently fall back to malformed scope handling without diagnostics.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:305-310 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `grep -vE '^(No previous AI autofix|Initial run — no previous commit)'` only filters the exact placeholder strings.
  WHY: Any upstream wording change would leak placeholder text into the reviewer scope file.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3467-3472 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `_ledger_count` rescans `ledger_status.txt` five times to compute the per-state counts.
  WHY: The repeated passes add avoidable I/O that a single awk pass could eliminate.
